title: What 'BP Care' Really Means After 35 — Simple Home Checks That Save Lives
description: 1 in 3 US adults over 35 has high BP — yet 46% don’t check at home. Learn when to act, how often to measure, and what spikes really mean.
reasoning: The surge reflects rising anxiety about inconsistent home readings (e.g., white-coat vs masked hypertension), confusion around thresholds like 140/90 or 180/110, and urgent need for practical, non-clinical guidance — users want clarity, not jargon, and actionable steps they can take *today*.
